'''BloodScar base''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] complex on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gepparin]], which had been converted into a headquarters of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organization known as [[BloodScar]]s. It was destroyed in [[0 ABY/Legends|0.5 ABY]], when the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Reprisal (Imperial II-class)|''Reprisal'']] [[Bombing of Gepparin|bombed]] the installation in attempt to kill an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|agent]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], who had infiltrated the pirate organization.

==Description==
The [[BloodScar]] base was built into a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] complex located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gepparin]], where the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] had been running their operation for about two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0.5 ABY]]. Part of the mining operation was still kept running to cover [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] shipping that was flying in and out of the base. The base was protected by [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. A miners preparation room had been turned into a welcoming center, where new arrivals could be searched with [[scanner]]s and detained with wall restraints if necessary.

==History==
The mining complex on Gepparing was used to produce low quality [[Ore/Legends|ore]], but about [[1 BBY/Legends|1.5 BBY]] BloodScar pirates took over the operation.

==Occupants==
{{Quote|How many crew are typically at the base?''"<br />"''Depends on whether there are any ships there. There are only thirty or so full-timers, but a couple of unloading ships could double that.|[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] and [[Tannis (pirate)|Tannis]]|<ref name="Allegiance (novel)">[[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]</ref>}}
The usual crew of the pirate base had about thirty people, including the leader of the BloodScar pirates, who was known as [[the Commodore]].
